# Bolt

## Docs

- [Accounts](https://support.bolt.new/account-and-subscription/account-management.md): Manage your Bolt and StackBlitz account.
- [Billing](https://support.bolt.new/account-and-subscription/billing.md): Billing and subscription management.
- [Corporate and commercial](https://support.bolt.new/account-and-subscription/corporate-commercial.md): Bolt for commercial use.
- [Teams plans](https://support.bolt.new/account-and-subscription/team-plans.md): Learn what Teams plans offer and how they support shared work across Bolt.
- [Teams: Plans, billing, tokens, and invoices](https://support.bolt.new/account-and-subscription/teams/billing-invoices.md): Learn about billing and invoices in Bolt Teams plans.
- [Manage your team](https://support.bolt.new/account-and-subscription/teams/manage-team.md): Manage members, roles, and seats for your Bolt team.
- [Team templates](https://support.bolt.new/account-and-subscription/teams/team-templates.md): Move faster by skipping repetitive project setup with team templates.
- [Tokens](https://support.bolt.new/account-and-subscription/tokens.md): Understand tokens, buy more, and token FAQs.
- [Plan before building with Plan or Discussion Mode](https://support.bolt.new/best-practices/discussion-mode.md): Chat with Bolt to get help without immediately generating code.
- [Maximize token efficiency](https://support.bolt.new/best-practices/maximizing-token-efficiency.md): Optimize token usage to keep your costs down.
- [Prompt effectively](https://support.bolt.new/best-practices/prompting-effectively.md): Tips for writing better prompts.
- [Plan your app](https://support.bolt.new/building/build-your-first-app.md): The lifecycle of an app, and how to work through it with Bolt.
- [Add your design system](https://support.bolt.new/building/design-system/add-design-system.md): Add your design system to build projects in Bolt using your company's UI guidelines and components.
- [Design system best practices](https://support.bolt.new/building/design-system/best-practices.md): Get the most out of your design system in Bolt with these tips for setup and prompting.
- [Introduction to design systems](https://support.bolt.new/building/design-system/introduction.md): Learn how design systems in Bolt help your team build high-fidelity, on-brand prototypes and user interfaces from your own components.
- [Sync your design system with Bolt](https://support.bolt.new/building/design-system/sync-design-system.md): Keep your design system in Bolt up to date when your sources change.
- [Use your design system to build with Bolt](https://support.bolt.new/building/design-system/use-design-system.md): Start a project with your design system so Bolt builds with your real components from the first prompt.
- [View your design system in Bolt](https://support.bolt.new/building/design-system/view-design-system.md): Browse your generated design system, find components, and manage your design system settings.
- [Intro to Bolt](https://support.bolt.new/building/intro-bolt.md): Learn what Bolt is, what you can build, and how to take your idea from prompt to published app.
- [Introduction to LLMs](https://support.bolt.new/building/intro-llms.md): Understand AI and LLMs.
- [Bolt QuickStart guide](https://support.bolt.new/building/quickstart.md): Build your first website or app with Bolt: no code required.
- [Switch your v1 projects to Bolt Agent](https://support.bolt.new/building/switch-v1-projects.md): Switch your v1 projects to Bolt Agent before August 3, 2026.
- [Choose an agent](https://support.bolt.new/building/using-bolt/agents.md): Learn about the agents you can use to build your Bolt projects.
- [Use Code View](https://support.bolt.new/building/using-bolt/code-view.md): Learn more about Bolt's workspace for exploring and editing your project’s files directly.
- [Collaborate with others](https://support.bolt.new/building/using-bolt/collaborate.md): Invite collaborators to your project or site, work together in real time, and share integrations across your team.
- [Connect to an MCP server](https://support.bolt.new/building/using-bolt/connect-mcp.md): Connect to an MCP server to give Bolt context from your external tools and data.
- [Using the chatbox](https://support.bolt.new/building/using-bolt/interacting-ai.md): Understand the main actions you can take in the Bolt chatbox and how each option supports your work.
- [Manage your projects](https://support.bolt.new/building/using-bolt/projects-files.md): Understand how to view, organize, and maintain your projects throughout their lifecycle in Bolt.
- [Backups, restore, and version history](https://support.bolt.new/building/using-bolt/rollback-backup.md): Restore a previous point in your project and manage backups using version history in the chat.
- [Share your project](https://support.bolt.new/building/using-bolt/sharing.md): Share your project, manage access, and invite collaborators.
- [Learn Bolt with video tutorials](https://support.bolt.new/building/video-tutorials.md): Video tutorials for every stage of building with Bolt.
- [What is Bolt Cloud?](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/bolt-cloud.md): Bring everything you need to launch your website or app together in one place.
- [Database](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database.md): Create and manage databases in Bolt without the need for third-party tools.
- [Database: Advanced settings](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/advanced.md): View and manage advanced settings for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Database: Authentication settings](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/authentication.md): View and manage authentication settings for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Database: File storage settings](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/file-storage.md): View and manage file storage settings for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Database: Logs](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/logs.md): View and manage logs for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Database: Secrets settings](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/secrets.md): View and manage your secrets settings for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Database: Security settings](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/security.md): View and manage the security settings for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Send emails from your Bolt app](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/send-emails.md): Send transactional and authentication emails from your Bolt app by connecting an email provider.
- [Server functions](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/server-functions.md): View and manage your server function settings for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Database: Tables](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/tables.md): View and manage the tables for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Database: FAQs](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/troubleshoot-db.md): Find answers to common questions about Bolt database.
- [Database: User Management](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/database/user-management.md): View and manage your User Management settings for your database in a Bolt project.
- [Domains](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/domains.md): Manage your project’s web address directly in Bolt. Purchase a new domain or connect an existing one, all from within your Project settings.
- [Domains: Aliases](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/domains/aliases.md): Add additional domains to your project as domain aliases.
- [Connect your domain](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/domains/connect.md): Connect a domain you own to one of your Bolt projects.
- [DNS records](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/domains/dns-records.md): Create, edit, and delete DNS records from your project settings.
- [Domains: Purchase a domain through Bolt](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/domains/purchase.md): Purchase domains directly inside your Bolt project.
- [Domains: Status, HTTPS, and SSL certificates](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/domains/ssl-https.md): Learn how to check the status of your connected domains and verify SSL certificates.
- [Domains: FAQs](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/domains/troubleshoot-domain.md): Find answers to common questions about purchasing, connecting, and using domains with Bolt.
- [Hosting](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/hosting.md): Bolt offers built-in hosting so you can publish your project without touching a server or setting up a third-party account.
- [Hosting: Analytics](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/hosting/analytics.md): View engagement with your published Bolt project.
- [Bolt Cloud hosting plans](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/hosting/plans.md): Publish your Bolt project for free or upgrade to a Pro plan for more bandwidth and additional features.
- [Publish your project to a live website](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/hosting/publish.md): Publish your project to a free `bolt.host` address.
- [SEO Boost](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/hosting/seo.md): Improve how search engines and social media platforms display your Bolt site.
- [Hosting: FAQs](https://support.bolt.new/cloud/hosting/troubleshoot-host.md): Find answers to common questions about hosting and publishing your projects with Bolt.
- [Glossary](https://support.bolt.new/concepts/glossary.md): Definitions for technical terms and Bolt-specific concepts you'll encounter while building.
- [Introduction to databases](https://support.bolt.new/concepts/intro-databases.md): Learn what databases are, why they matter, and how Bolt makes them easy to use.
- [Supported technologies](https://support.bolt.new/concepts/supported-technologies.md): Technologies you can use with Bolt.
- [Version history, version control, and GitHub](https://support.bolt.new/concepts/version-history-github.md): Learn why version history and control matter, and where GitHub fits.
- [Referral program](https://support.bolt.new/external-resources/referral-program.md): Refer your friends to get free tokens.
- [Expo for mobile apps](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/expo.md): Using Bolt with Expo to create mobile apps and publish them to app stores.
- [Figma for design](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/figma.md): Bolt integrates directly with Figma to import designs and generate code.
- [GitHub for version control](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/git.md): Bolt integrates directly with GitHub, handling all commit and update operations automatically.
- [Set up GitHub organization access](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/github-org.md): Give your GitHub organization admins control over which repositories Bolt users can access.
- [Google SSO for authentication](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/google-sso.md): Bolt integrates directly with Google to handle user authentication.
- [Use Google Stitch designs in Bolt](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/google-stitch.md): Export your Google Stitch designs to Bolt and build them into a fully functional app.
- [Import from Lovable](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/lovable-import.md): Import a project from Lovable into Bolt.
- [Netlify for hosting](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/netlify.md): You can publish your projects using Bolt hosting, or you can connect them to Netlify for deployment through their platform.
- [Stripe for payments](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/stripe.md): Bolt integrates directly with Stripe to handle user payments and subscriptions.
- [Supabase for databases](https://support.bolt.new/integrations/supabase.md): Use Supabase with Bolt to add a database, authentication, or edge functions to your app as an alternative to Bolt Database.
- [Account settings](https://support.bolt.new/settings/account-settings.md): Personalize Bolt's appearance and behavior, connect applications, and manage your knowledge, connectors, and add-on features.
- [Project settings](https://support.bolt.new/settings/project-settings.md): Rename your project, manage domains and hosting, view analytics, set project knowledge, and restore backups.
- [Team settings](https://support.bolt.new/settings/team-settings.md): Control member roles, publishing, integrations, and data exports for your team. Only team admins can access these settings.
- [Workspace settings](https://support.bolt.new/settings/workspace-settings.md): Manage your subscription, tokens, Cloud usage, knowledge, and shared team resources for your workspace.
- [Contact support](https://support.bolt.new/troubleshooting/contact-support.md): Get the answers you need to keep building great things.
- [Integrations issues](https://support.bolt.new/troubleshooting/integrations-issues.md): Troubleshooting for integrations.
- [Bolt issues](https://support.bolt.new/troubleshooting/issues.md): Tips for troubleshooting common issues and errors in Bolt.
- [Login issues](https://support.bolt.new/troubleshooting/login-issues.md): Troubleshooting for issues logging into Bolt.
